weight_mode: Normalized evaluation cell areas; constant across time slices and GP snapshots
run_end: End waypoint selection when no next leg and onward return fit; continue 1 Hz sampling through Nav2 return. Actual Home arrival must fall within the 300 s mission budget.
initial_gp: SRF synthetic history from the same realization; fixed real-data-fitted RBF hyperparameters, no kernel refit
reconstruction: Retrospective final posterior over the common full [0,300] domain; not a forecasting test
gp_update: Every 1 s; all observations retained; fixed kernel hyperparameters
grg_update: Single worker, one replaceable latest-state signal, no FIFO; current search completes, next search starts with latest offered GP/context
goal_switch: Switch sampling goals only at arrival and retain the sampling route tail. Home is reserved for spawn and final return.
execution_mode: Latest-GP background EMSE scheduling; retained route with arrival-only handoff
terminal_residual: Keep all valid sampling and return measurements through Home arrival; stop offering GRG searches at return dispatch.
